SITUATION REPORT: @WAR_MONITOR & CHINA, INDIA

OVERVIEW:

In the conflict in Ukraine, the @war_monitor Telegram channel reports that funds collected for Mavic 3T drones and reinforced batteries for a special forces unit have been successfully delivered (see [#1]). Regarding the Kyiv region, the channel reports ongoing reconnaissance activity (see [#2]) and identifies specific rocket strikes or incidents in the Obukhiv sector (see [#3]), Chaban (see [#4]), and near Osokorky/Pyrogiv (see [#5]).

In China-related developments, a former Anthropic researcher has warned that Chinese intelligence assets are already present within United States AI laboratories (see [#7]). In the realm of trade and diplomacy, reports indicate that Donald Trump has urged Xi Jinping to engage in discussions with Takaichi and to lift export curbs on Japan (see [#8]). Additionally, the United States has issued its first fine regarding outbound investment related to a Chinese robotics AI deal (see [#9]).

In India, law enforcement engaged in a high-speed pursuit of three smugglers transporting banned tobacco products, resulting in the suspects being apprehended (see [#6]). In sports news, the captain of the Indian women's cricket team, who led the nation to a 2025 World Cup victory, has stepped down from her role across all three formats of the game (see [#10]).

SITUATION REPORT: @WAR_MONITOR & CHINA, INDIA

OVERVIEW:

Military activity in Ukraine remains concentrated in the Kyiv region, with multiple reports of rocket strikes and tactical movements. In Zhytomyr, one rocket was reported (see [#1]). Within the Kyiv region, significant activity was noted in the Obukhiv/Trypillya area (see [#2]), the Vasylkiv sector (see [#3], see [#16]), and near the Kyiv Reservoir (see [#16]). Additional reports indicate rocket activity or strikes in the Chornobyl zone, Dimer, Borodyanka, Makariv, Vyshhorod, Hostomel, Bucha, Irpin, Svyatopetrivske, Chaban, and Ivankiv (see [#5], see [#7], see [#8], see [#9], see [#10], see [#11], see [#18]). Furthermore, a rocket was reported traveling from Cherkasy toward the Bila Tserkva district (see [#15]), and another rocket was noted moving from Bila Tserkva toward the Vasylkiv sector (see [#17]).

In broader geopolitical and technological developments, China is reportedly analyzing drone tactics utilized in the Ukraine conflict to refine its own military capabilities (see [#12]). In the energy sector, a Chinese technological breakthrough is projected to increase the gross profit margin of sustainable jet fuel to over 50% (see [#14]). Regarding international relations, Flavio Bolsonaro has indicated that, should he serve as President of Brazil, he would seek to maintain working relationships with both China and the United States (see [#13]).
